reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience! The staff were so lovely, friendly and welcoming, and made me feel completely comfortable leaving the dog with them. You can really tell how much they care about the dogs they groom. My dog looks absolutely amazing and so much better — I’m so pleased with the result as is the dog who must feel 100 times lighter! Thank you so much for doing such a brilliant job. We’ll definitely be coming back! 🐶❤️
First time for a puppy cut for my maltese cockapoo lovely staff showed me how to groom my dog properly good advice thank you would most definitely recommend 🙂

Absolutely fantastic grooming parlour, they did both of my dogs. Exceptional service dogs smelt lovely, well groomed. They even clipped my bully’s claws which is a mammoth task as we have took him many places that can’t do it as he would not keep still or allow it, this company worked with my dog for trust and he returned with all nails clipped. So happy 😀

Hands down the best dog groomers I have ever been too, I have tried multiple dog groomers and really thought it was impossible to get the perfect cut till I went to Freshpaws. Can’t fault the service and absolutely wicked people in there.
Safe to say Luna has found her forever place for her trims.
Thanks a lot to everyone at fresh paws appreciate you looking after Luna 👍🏼
I highly recommend Freshpaws , A groomers that genuinely care , my dog is very happy to go to the grooming salon and always looks amazing when i pick him up .
Excellent service lovely people how they look after my older poorly dog,  his like a new dog when leaving

I have been taking my cavapoochon Floki here for just over a year now. They do such an amazing job with his grooming no complaints at all. Sometimes the lady makes suggestions when i am not sure on how i want him cut and he always comes out looking amazing.
The customer serivice here is 5 star!!!
10/10
Been taking my dog here for a couple of years now. The team are all lovely and pup ends up looking very fresh and I know he’s well looked after :) thanks!

10/10 would recommend to anyone, our King Charles Cavalier, Seb was a little nervous going to a new groomer for the first time after a bad experience elsewhere. But since his first visit to Freshpaws, he now bursts through the doors and can’t wait to see everyone. He always comes home fresh, smelling amazing and smiling with a very waggy tail.

Absolutely fantastic! Sharon, H & the rest of the team are so lovely and welcoming. It was my first time and I’ll be sure to bring my pup back here again. She was well looked after and even the aftercare information was great. I was recommended FreshPaws and I’ll be sure to keep on recommending too. Thank you guys and I’ll see you back in 6 weeks! 🐾

So happy with Milo's groom today, this was his first professional groom, he was a little hesitant when I left, but Sharon and the team were great with him, he looks like a new dog (puppy) will defo return, thank you so much :) x

First groom at FreshPaws today for my 1 year old Cocker - Dotty! Really impressed, the attention to detail, asking lots of questions about how I wanted the cut to be, legs, head tail etc, and lots of care given regarding the animal too, asking how she is with groomers normally, or any additional needs. Picked up Dotty after receiving a phone call to say she was done, and she looks beautiful, really well groomed, Dotty was happy and comfortable - very well looked after. Next appointment booked in for 8 weeks time, very happy owner, and dog!!
Took our Shih tzu for her first puppy cut. Karen and the team are very friendly and professional.  Highly recommend 👌 …

I have been taking my Golden Retriever to Freshpaws for 4 years to get her nails clipped. She doesn’t enjoy the experience but Sharan and H are nothing short of fantastic. They work so efficiently and professionally to get them done as quickly as possible. They constantly talk and reassure my dog and let me come and be with her as well. So while I am there I see how caring and chatty they are with all the other dogs in their care! Can’t recommend them enough!
Lovely people.Charlie loves going here.

I have been a customer  with Giff my Yorkie at Freshpaws since it opened and it has been a really fantastic experience. He has been well looked after on the grooming side by the brilliant staff. On his visit we were advised by the staff that he had a broken dewclaw and that we pop into the local vet which we did. The removed the dewclaw and found that Giff had another condition, not serious that needed treatment. If it wasn’t for the skills and expertise of the FreshPaws staff we wouldn’t have known. So may thanks to you for your care and attention to Giff
Len
Hi Omair thank you for the review from us all at Freshpaws
Fantastic service. Our dog is very nervous after a bad experience at another groomers and they were so patient and did a beautiful job. Will always bring him here. Great price too!

Took our little Yorkshire terrier today for the first time. Thank you for doing an amazing job he looks beautiful! Staff are very friendly too and understand what you want your pup to have done. We’ve been to 2 other places before and came out half done and looking the same. Definitely will be back ❤️

Had our french bulldog dog nails cut.
No issues..
Would recommend

After finding it difficult to find a groomer for our cockapoo Edie, we finally found Fresh Paws. Her cut is beautiful every time and she has settled there well - the owner is knowledgeable and articulate- striving to understand your needs and those of your dog. Would highly recommend
Hi thank you for the review from us all at Freshpaws

Had my cocker spaniel Lady trimmed and groomed for the first time today at Freshpaws, I’m very pleased with the result, my girl looks beautiful, the lady asked me how much I wanted them to trim off and explained what they would do to make Lady comfortable, will definitely be back, thank you for your patience with Lady ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Put my trust in freshpaws for my 8 years old cockerpoo. My previous groomers had not trimmed his coat very well but freshoaws surpassed my expectations. The groom was fantastic and his fur is so soft and I want to cuddle him all the time. I will certainly be taking him back every 6 weeks. 👍🐶👍 …

Just moved up from kent where we had a regular groomer who did a great job my dog is a shih-tzu x poodle and loves a muddy puddle 9 years old so absolutely need regular visits I've tried a few groomers up this way now and they've not been great, but honestly this is the best cut he's ever had the staff are so friendly and really take care on what you want and what products they use also great aftercare advice I would highly recommend to any pet owner
If I could give more than 5 stars I would!! All the staff are very welcoming, friendly and very informative, my dog jack come out looking very handsome, very happy and now new customers xx
Hi Ashleigh thank you for the review from us all at Freshpaws

I took my two Cocker  Spaniels to be groomed and wow what a lovey job they did. They both came out happy and looking gorgeous!
They are explained fully what they’ll do. I’m so happy can’t wait till July when we visit this lovely salon again!
What a great team, Sharron, H, Chrissie and another lovely lady I didn’t get her name unfortunately.
Thank you so much
Jennie
Thank you for the review
Greeted with a friendly welcome and of course the dog is happy to go , he always looks great after his groom

So pleased with my long haired chihuahuas grooming service. Didn’t know what to expect as hadn’t had him professionally groomed before. But my doggy came out perfectly trimmed, and looking so handsome. He smelt amazing, couldn’t stop cuddling him. Highly recommend FreshPaws, with a reasonable price of £42 for the full works!!
Third time taking my Pomeranian Bijou here for grooming and they make her look clean and neat everytime! Everyone is friendly at the establishment and I would recommend bringing your dog here💕 …

Excellent friendly service, my dog always looks amazing when I pick him up. I would highly recommend them. my dog went to 2 other groomers, who did what was easy for them  and not what I wanted.  I so grateful I found Freshpaws, who listened to  what I wanted, I will never go anywhere else.  the owner and staff are lovely.

The first time I used freshpaws today for a full groom I was recommended them! Wow, what can I say they were amazing.
stupidly I thought I booked an appointment at Fresh Paws on Facebook I went to the appointment well to cut a long story short I booked a Fresh Paws based in Scotland! They were so kind to me, they had a spare hour and offered me an appointment I was so grateful. They were brilliant with our cockapoo she looked beautiful at the end and smelt lovely. I am so happy with their service I have booked again. Big thank you to Freshpaws you were fabulous from start to finish.

I cannot put into words how pleased I am with FreshPaws!!! They did an absolutely fab job!!! My little chihuahua looks absolutely amazing! 😍 It’s the best he’s ever been groomed- stunning cut and he smells amazing! 😍🩷 Thank you so so much guys! And thank you so so much all for being so lovely to me and for looking after Chochii!! 🩷 …
Hi thank you for the review from us all at Freshpaws
Fantastic service - highly recommended

Had to find a new groomers as where I took mine 2 shih tzu they had closed, after looking at the reviews for freshpaws decided to book an appointment, dropped my babies off, absolutely lovely welcome from groomer, after a couple of hours they was ready I could of cried when I saw them they looked so adorable, can’t thank you enough see you in 7 weeks
Thank you for the review from us all at Freshpaws
Very friendly and always kind and attentive to our little Yorkie. Lexi, from Chris x
